active_work_package.title: The P0.7 design: row-level security enforcement, as docs/architecture/p0/P0.07-rls-enforcement.md at PROPOSED - issue #251
active_work_package.objective: Resolve ticket #141 on the P0 design map under the pack's template and the map's charting decision 8: write the P0.7 design with its nine mandatory sections, the policy shape per table with its rules quoted from the RLS research, the tenant key under each pooling mode with what must be measured, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and the lint that refuses disabling it, the fifteen documented leak paths each assigned a fate with its check or owner, the application-bypass test as a test-only entry point seen failing before the policies exist, ten negative controls covering the matrix's read, write, delete and bypass rows, the evidence contract, candidates pending ADR-004 and ADR-001, eight open questions with ASSUMED positions, and a two-package cut; link it from the P0 manual's row.

stop_reason: WP-080 is done on this branch and awaits merge after review, as for WP-029 through WP-079. The P0.7 design, row-level security enforcement, is at PROPOSED under docs/architecture/p0/: four permissive policies per tenant-owned table comparing the row's tenant_id with the transaction's key and nothing else, USING filtering and WITH CHECK erroring, the tenant table as the one exception; the key under each pooling mode with transaction pooling the only mode the design is written for and the pooler a measurement; every table forced and a lint refusing any migration that disables or unforces; the research's fifteen leaks each given a fate, eleven closed by design with the P0.6 ownership tests or a lint as the check, two accepted with a named check, two owned elsewhere; the application-bypass test as a test-only entry point excluded from every deployable artifact and seen failing before the policies exist, with the phase stopping if the baseline cannot fail; ten negative controls; candidates pending ADR-004 and ADR-001; eight open questions with ASSUMED positions. The manual's order continues with P0.5 and P0.10. The primary action is unchanged: NS-041, the operator's #92 waiver on #27. Unchanged: NS-040 (#78), NS-024 (#93), NS-042 (#94), NS-044, NS-033 (#52), NS-003 to NS-005 of docs/NEXT_STEPS.md for the repository owner, the oracle author, experiment re-run NOT_GRANTED; #81 is a content decision an agent should not take.
